Architect and administer Windows Server and directory services at scale, including Active Directory, Entra ID, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, PKI, and failover clustering. Engineer and operate Linux as a first class platform, including build standards, configuration management, patching, hardening, and performance tuning. Drive observability, monitoring, alerting, backup, and disaster recovery across every Compute platform, including regular recovery testing rather than assumed recoverability. Lead complex infrastructure projects end to end, from requirements through implementation, stabilization, and post launch review.
